purpose: A last trip into odd languages, to see what other people made for the sake of it.

pages.title: Esoteric programming language
pages.reaction: A tidy little front door to the whole odd-languages scene. Brainfuck and Malbolge sound like they were named by someone who wanted to be left alone. I like that INTERCAL's whole point was to be as unlike normal languages as possible. Gave me a warm nudge toward the Timeline, not much more.

pages.title: Timeline of esoteric programming languages
pages.reaction: A timeline that is half history and half joke. The 2038 and February 32nd entries are pure fun, and the ~ATH entry made me laugh.
